craft_evidence.owned: yes, as stated by the brand: history page (2023) cites 'one of three Carhartt WIP-owned production facilities in Tunisia' and a manufacturing video; sustainability page: almost one third of garments made in Tunisia at company-owned or long-term partner facilities; facilities not named, no filing seen
craft_evidence.makers: none named on PDPs (225 description bullet lists read)
craft_evidence.mills: none; cloth names (Dearborn, Smith, Camano etc.) are house fabric names with no mill named
craft_evidence.madein: 0 of 225 (no country of origin in PDP description bullets; two PDP payloads checked had no origin field)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: 1989 Edwin Faeh All American Concept importing Carhartt to Europe; 1994 Work in Progress established as exclusive Carhartt distributor in Europe; 1996 licence to manufacture Carhartt outside the USA; 1997 first store Neal Street London (history page); parent Carhartt 1889 Detroit
craft_evidence.process: partial: PDPs give cloth weight, fit, triple stitching and bartacks; history page cites the video Many Hands, One Double Knee Pant documenting manufacture at a WIP-owned Tunisian facility; sustainability page documents supplier audits and Retraced traceability (594 suppliers)
craft_evidence.reasoning: Carhartt WIP says it owns three production facilities in Tunisia and that almost a third of garments are made there by owned or long-term partner facilities (history and sustainability pages), which is more than a 3 usually has. But no facility is named, no product page states a country of origin, and no mill or maker is named anywhere in the range, so a reader cannot tie any garment to the owned making. Proposed 3; 4 if Sebastian accepts the brand's own ownership statement and factory video as evidence.

ownership.owner: Work in Progress Textilhandels GmbH, Weil am Rhein (HRB 412212, Local Court Freiburg; managing directors Willem Kampert, Heinfried Schmidt-Jenne, Philipp Maiburg, Tobias Öhme), described on the imprint as Carhartt WIP authorized distributor; operates under licence from Carhartt Inc. (licence to manufacture outside the USA since 1996 per history page); US shop run by WIP ECOM LLC, 599 Broadway, New York; shareholders not read (filings not reached)

opview: “Make things well, make them last, let the product speak, that's our starting point for sustainability.” — Wilfried Atzert, CEO of Carhartt WIP, Carhartt WIP Sustainability page (US store)
